description: Header file defining interface for the STM32F10x Independent Watchdog (IWDG) firmware library, including constants, macros, and function prototypes.

methods.name: IWDG_WriteAccessCmd
methods.description: Sets the write access to the IWDG registers.

methods.name: IWDG_SetPrescaler
methods.description: Configures the prescaler value for the IWDG.

methods.name: IWDG_SetReload
methods.description: Sets the reload value for the IWDG counter.

methods.name: IWDG_ReloadCounter
methods.description: Reloads the IWDG counter to prevent reset.

methods.name: IWDG_GetFlagStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of specified IWDG flags.
